system.description:
• Effect: You are now immune to your chosen element's damage entirely.
  • When struck by a spell of that element, make a Wisdom check against the spell's save DC
  • Succeed on the check: the spell is reflected back at a target of the Druid's choice for its original damage

activities.name: Reflect Spell
activities.text: Out of turn, when struck by a spell of your chosen element: beat its save DC to reflect it at a target of your choice for its original damage.
